summary.intent: Execute the gsd plan-phase workflow for phase 45 of the cipher-box project, which involves researching and planning a Rust FUSE write-journal/replay hygiene refactor.
summary.outcome: The workflow reached the research stage and successfully spawned a gsd-phase-researcher agent that wrote a RESEARCH.md file for phase 45. Planning and verification steps were not yet executed.

repo: Phase 45 is scoped to a Rust-only hygiene refactor of FUSE write-journal/replay code with 7 scope items and no behavior changes — MVP mode, UI gates, and schema-push gates do not apply.
The gsd plan-phase workflow has a structured gate system: phase status validation, MVP mode resolution, CONTEXT.md presence check, and user confirmation before spawning agents.
The workflow supports --research-phase, --research, --view, --skip-research, --gaps, --skip-verify, --prd, --ingest, --reviews, --text, and --mvp flags with distinct behaviors.
When no CONTEXT.md exists, the workflow prompts the user before proceeding rather than auto-continuing.

code.finding: Research output file created by gsd-phase-researcher agent for phase 45.

workflow: The gsd plan-phase orchestrator separates research, planning, and verification into discrete stages with user gates between them.
Spawning subagents for research is announced with a liveness indicator per ui-brand.md conventions to set user expectations during silent subagent execution.
Phase status must be Pending (not closed) before the workflow proceeds; a closed phase would fire a gate.
